runs.text: Capturing the best ideas in a single portfolio
A globally diversified portfolio of our best fixed income ideas, which we believe could prove itself in different market environments.
A dedicated team of more than 50 analysts providing in-depth coverage of the global fixed income investment universe.
Fixed income and equity teams collaborate for greater access to companies and multiple perspectives.
Bridging global fixed income markets with high-quality bonds

The fund seeks to provide, over the long term, a high level of total return consistent with prudent investment management by investing globally in investment grade bonds of governmental, supranational and corporate issuers as well as other fixed-income securities.
Morningstar Global Large-Cap Growth Equity category.
